statement_zh: 本流程共检测 148 个统计假设（1 类终点）。族内与全局均采用 Benjamini–Hochberg（BH）校正：未校正时 141 个达到 p<0.05；族内校正后 141 个（q_family<0.05）；全局校正后 141 个（q_global<0.05）。**q_global 是唯一可写入结论的显著性口径**；仅 p<0.05 而未通过 q 的结果只能表述为"提示性关联"。
statement_en: A total of 148 statistical hypotheses across 1 endpoint families were tested. Multiplicity was controlled with Benjamini–Hochberg correction both within family and globally: 141 hypotheses reached p<0.05 before correction, 141 after within-family correction (q_family<0.05), and 141 after global correction (q_global<0.05). Only q_global<0.05 is reported as significant; results passing nominal p alone are described as suggestive.
